And the DOWNs would have moved it to rows 42-47. But it's still at rows 27-32. So the DOWNs weren't executed at all. Only 7 LEFTs. So the batch was truncated at 7.
Hmm, or maybe the environment only processes up to 7 actions per call. Let me proceed in batches of ≤7.
